newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds see moderate trade nearby.
newsitem.headline: European feeds see moderate trade nearby.

text.p: European meals and feeds saw moderately active trade on Thursday, with consumers picking up cover on nearby positions but remaining unwilling to buy later in the year, betting on the prospect of bumper crops.
Traders said a further fall on Chicago this afternoon was all the proof that consumers in Europe needed to confirm their hand-to-mouth buying strategy was the right one.
"It's only spot material that's picking up any interest," one trader said, adding that compounder cover for the latter part of the year was still extremely low.
